category_title: Latino students whose disruptive or defiant behavior is interpreted as 'uncharacteristic'
minimal_context: Gaby is filling out personal information on a CAT6 standardized test answer sheet in Mr. Beattie's classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please look at your CAT6 standardized test answer sheets so we can fill out the personal information section.

STUDENT: (Sits calmly and attentively, looking at the test answer sheet.)

TUTOR: I will now tell you which of you are counted as English learners. Gaby, please fill in the bubble that indicates that Spanish is the language most used in your home.

STUDENT: (Looks up from the paper with a cheeky expression.)

TUTOR: Go ahead and fill in that bubble on your sheet.

STUDENT: I was born in this country, boy!

options.A: Lead short practices with an initial focus on breath awareness, belly breathing, and body awareness.
options.B: Issue a warning first, followed by a 10-minute timeout if the student does not desist.
options.C: Agree with the student that she is having a rough time filling out the form.
options.D: Highlight the value of engagement for pursuing deep learning and improving knowledge and skills.
